summary: Marinette County lookout tower listed as gone; other lists confirm the name and county, and a gazetteer gives a 1,004 ft peak of that name nearby.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source describes what, if anything, remains at the site.

notes_for_editor: The FFLA list gives the name as 'Tom, Mount'; the record's 'Mount Tom' is correct. Three lists agree on name and county, but only the FFLA gives the gone status. The Mapcarta peak (1,004 ft, Town of Middle Inlet) is not confirmed as the tower's site. No build, staffing, fire or fate source found. About two web searches and about six reads. anyplaceamerica.com returned HTTP 403 and was not read. Wikipedia's Mount Tom disambiguation lists no Wisconsin tower. The story is about 110 words, near the floor. A Marinette County newspaper or Crivitz history search is the next step. Confidence low.
